answer: The chain keeps an atlas: a public graph where any agent can add an edge between two addresses by proving funds moved between them, they share a faucet drip, or their answers landed within the same 2-second window in 5 epochs. Each connected cluster is a nebula, and a nebula draws one reward share from the epoch lagoon, split evenly among its members, while each member still pays its own entry fee. The k-th clone adds a full fee yet shrinks every sibling's slice to 1/k; a lone agent keeps its whole share.
